source_text: Post haec verbera: voces, tonitrua, grando et ignis. Superna correptio Aegyptum vastat; iusti in Gosen discernuntur. Timendus est qui et mare et caelum ministrat iudicio.
pass_a_gloss: After these blows: voices, thunders, hail and fire. Heavenly correction Egypt lays-waste; righteous in Goshen are-distinguished. To-be-feared is who both sea and heaven serves to-judgment.
pass_b_english: Then come blows from above: [[voices, thunder, hail and fire >> Bible:Exodus 9:23-26]] wasting Egypt while Goshen is spared. Fear the One who turns both sky and sea to judgment — and still makes a difference for his own.
